fields.statement: Verifier at fce29b5a: read the diff (internal/api/ship.go adds shipRerunsSpent, inserting ' after <n> reruns' after the failed checks when reruns were spent on the head, and shipDiffOnlyRhiza, appending '; the PR changes only .rhiza/' when git merge-base origin/main..head diff --name-only lists only .rhiza/ paths, any git error or empty diff giving no note). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api/ -run TestShipCheckFailureDetailNotes -v: PASS for all 3 cases (fake gh with git answered through the same fake Exec, as every ship test does): .rhiza-only gives 'failed: test after 2 reruns; failing tests: TestGarden; the PR changes only .rhiza/'; with main.go too it gives the same without the note; a lint check whose log reports a stale .rhiza/rendered/ file gives 'failed: lint after 2 reruns; the PR changes only .rhiza/'.
